name: exposure2d_confirm_dose256

nearby.construction: independently simulated reservoir events assigned one-to-one by maximum bipartite matching inside a state-distance quantile band

arms.B: 64 independent replacement trajectories under fresh appearances
arms.C: the 64 source trajectories under appearances unique within the block
arms.D: one independent neighbor per source, closer than anything in base training: RMS state distance in [0.25, 0.5] x the source's nearest base-training distance
arms.D2: one reservoir-selected independent neighbor per source in the 0.1st-1st percentile band of pairwise independent distances (comparable to base-training nearest neighbors)
arms.E: the exact renders forming the exact population (diagnostic reference, not a ceiling)

populations.source: 4 held-out renders per source trajectory, unseen by every arm
populations.exact: the render E trains on; unseen by B, C, and D
populations.independent: 512 independently sampled trajectories under fresh appearances

exposure_dose: 800 arm-slot presentations over 256 sources: 3-4 presentations per source
primary_metric: mean over examples of per-disk-frame Euclidean center error, capped at 1 arena width; nonfinite outputs receive the cap
seed_derivation: numpy SeedSequence(entropy=experiment_seed, spawn_key=(block_index,)) spawned into data, schedule, base_batches, torch roles

decision_contract.interval: two-sided 95% t intervals over block-level paired contrasts for support; two-sided 90% for absence (negligible)

event_identity.event_specific: Holm-adjusted secondary test rejects H0: Q <= 0.010 (one-sided alpha 0.025 within the secondary family)
event_identity.below_threshold: upper95(Q) < 0.010 (descriptive: specificity below the consequential threshold, not absence of specificity)

primary_claim.consequential reuse advantage: consequential magnitude, source gain supported, harm bounded
primary_claim.prevalence_dependent reuse advantage: prevalence-dependent magnitude, source gain supported, harm bounded
primary_claim.differential gap without safeguards: any positive magnitude with a failed safeguard
primary_claim.inconclusive: otherwise, ANY unresolved block failure (for every claim), or fewer screened blocks than the minimum
primary_claim.positive control not detected: negligible magnitude but positive control not detected (sensitivity unresolved)

secondary.identity_specific: H0: Q <= 0.010 (Q against the closer-than-base-training arm D)
secondary.multiplicity: Holm step-down at one-sided 0.025 across identity_specific, detectable, consequential_harm; the event-identity axis label follows the Holm decision.
secondary.identity_planning: With pilot v4 Q upper SD 0.00063 and about 260 screened blocks, P(identity claim) exceeds 0.9 when true Q >= 0.0102.

decision_contract.break_even_rules: pi* = m/G: finite interval [m/upper(G), m/lower(G)] when lower(G) > 0; unbounded above when lower(G) <= 0 < upper(G); no positive crossing when upper(G) <= 0; also reported intersected with [0, 1].
decision_contract.crossover: Fieller confidence set for mean(H)/mean(G): bounded interval, two rays, or the entire line
decision_contract.analyzer: scripts/analyze_2d.py (imports the frozen 1D validation, interval, Holm, break-even and Fieller code; SHA-256 bound in the freeze manifest)
decision_contract.record_integrity: The analyzer requires exactly one record per registered block index; recomputes every contrast from component errors and the competence screen from its recorded errors (stored contrasts and flags are ignored); requires finite errors in [0, 1] and per-item losses that average to the errors (tolerance 1e-5); and checks that the export's identity (configuration hash, experiment seed, manifest hash, frozen code commit) matches the approved run.
decision_contract.completeness_rule: Decisive claims require every registered block to complete. The metric is bounded in [0, 1], so one missing block could move mean harm by up to 1/800, more than the harm margin; no observed-data imputation is conservative. Infrastructure failures are deterministic to rerun with identical seeds and must be resolved before analysis; any remaining failure makes decisive claims inconclusive (estimates still reported). For Experiment 3 this complete-block rule takes precedence over the general missing-data rule.
decision_contract.scope_of_confirmatory_claims: Confirmatory: the matched exposure assay (magnitude, safeguards, positive control) and the Holm secondary family (identity_specific, detectable, consequential_harm). Detector predictions H3.3-H3.5 become confirmatory only if their audit contract (thresholds and ties, negative-family resampling, extraction-failure handling, Holm family) is frozen in the November 20 amendment before any 2D test outcome is scored; otherwise exploratory. Filtering (H3.6) is confirmatory only if frozen before unblinding; otherwise exploratory. Q2 and the distance profile are descriptive.
decision_contract.error_control_statement: Each declaration controls its own error: support at one-sided 2.5%, absence by TOST at 5% per side, secondary claims by Holm at familywise one-sided 2.5%. Competing declarations are not jointly controlled: at G = 0.002 the probability of a false positive-magnitude or false negligible declaration is about 7.5%. No study-wide FWER across experiments is claimed.
decision_contract.role_in_family: This configuration is an axis of the Experiment 3 secondary family, analyzed jointly with the main confirmation by scripts/analyze_exp3_axes.py (one Holm family). Its own four-axis classification is descriptive.

freeze_requirement: A confirmatory manifest validated by scripts/freeze.py BEFORE the run starts (require_approval_to_run) and again at analysis: configuration and analyzer (scripts/analyze_2d.py) SHA-256; frozen code commit, HEAD differing only under approvals/; dated, named sign-offs for paper_lead and stats_check (internal signers; external review is welcome but not on the critical path); a decision statement; every pilot seed in the registry. Provisional (owner-only) manifests are rejected (allow_provisional_freeze: false). The manifest also carries the environment block (lockfile hash, pinned runtime versions and their hash, hardware class A100); a run on another hardware class or runtime is refused unless a logged deviation is given. One manifest binds all five Experiment 3 configurations by name.
claim_boundary: Effect of replacing 64 independent continuation events with same-trajectory 2D rerenders for this ConvLSTM, dose, and continuation phase.
sample_size_rationale: 800 scheduled blocks: the smallest value on the grid {100,200,400,600,800,1000} giving at least 95% power for both primary decisions (consequential claim at G=0.015, H=0.0005; negligible claim with assay sensitivity at G=0, E=0.002) when true block SDs are twice the 80% upper limits from the effect-blinded 2D pilot (S 0.00519, H 0.00110, G 0.00547, Q 0.00411, E 0.00748; 23 screened blocks). Simulated error rates at the boundaries stay near nominal (about 0.025 for a consequential call at G=0.010; about 0.05 for a negligible call at G=0.002). results/exposure2d_plan.json; end-to-end dry run through the analyzer: results/exposure2d_dryrun_sd1.json and results/exposure2d_dryrun_sd2.json.
base_competence_screen: Pre-treatment screen on a separate 256-event competence population (never scored in contrasts): a block enters the primary analysis iff its base model's bounded error there is below constant velocity's. All blocks reported; an analysis over all completed blocks is a sensitivity analysis.

closer_nearby.construction: box-conditioned band distribution: uniform initial-state prior restricted to a sensitivity-scaled box (half-width 2.5 x band maximum / local sensitivity, capped at the full parameter range) and conditioned on RMS state distance in [0.25, 0.5] x the source's nearest base-training distance
closer_nearby.containment_validation: results/closer_sampler_validation_2d.json (box 2.5 vs 3.0, reservoir agreement); empirical, not a proof
closer_nearby.box_multiplier_rationale_2d: In the 9-parameter 2D state space the 1D multiplier (6) makes the proposal box nearly the full range and acceptance infeasible (no proposal accepted in 2M). 2.5 is feasible. The registered target is the box-conditioned distribution; a diagnostic check (2.5 vs 3.0; reservoir comparison) detected no difference (results/closer_sampler_validation_2d.json). Not a proof of containment.

failure_policy: Infrastructure errors (OSError, MemoryError, device/MPS runtime errors) retry once with identical seeds; other exceptions are algorithmic failures. All failures are recorded.
runtime_estimate: 448 s of compute per block (1,024 held-out renders); 200 blocks about 8.5 h wall with 3 concurrent blocks.
secondary_endpoints_note: Raw records retain per-render bounded center-error losses only; contact-timing and post-contact-velocity endpoints are not part of this confirmation.
base_training_steps_rationale_2d: Fixed from effect-blind base-only tuning (results/exposure2d_base_tuning.json): at 300 steps the 2D base model only marginally beats constant velocity on the screen (error ratio 0.93-0.98); at 600 steps it is clearly competent (0.68-0.72) and later checkpoints plateau.
purpose: Dose-response axis, low dose: the registered ConvLSTM-16 design with 256 reused source trajectories, so each reused trajectory is presented about 3 times.
